ti.title: ቤዛ ናይ ይስሓቅ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ብሓሶት ምስክር ከሰሱ ንጐይታ (2)
ብሞት ንኽቕጻዕ ጨርሑ ብዓውታ (2)
[[/chorus]]

ቤዛ ናይ ይስሓቅ ኣምላከ ኣብርሃም (2)
ንኹሎም ወገኑ ዓደጎም ብደም (2)

ጲላጦስ ገረፎ ሰንሰለት ብምእሳር (2)
ምስ መንግስተ ሮማ ብሓሳብ ብምስማር (2)

ኣብ ዝፋን ናይ ብርሃን ዝቖማ ኣእጋር (2)
ከመይ ተዓገሳ ንናይ መስቀል ሽንካር (2)

ti_ro.title: Beza nay yshaq
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Beza nay yshaq amlake abrham (2)
[[/chorus]]

Nkhulom wegenu adegom bdem (2)
Bhasot mskr kesesu ngoyta (2)
Bmot nkhqtsa cherhu bawta (2)
Pilatos gerefo senselet bmsar (2)
Ms mengste roma bhasab bmsmar (2)
Dngl aykealetn keteqwarts nbat (2)
Nareayet weda ksaqe sqyat (2)
Ab zfan nay brhan zqoma agar (2)
Kemey teagesa nnay mesqel shnkar (2)
Akhlil nay brhan ab semay zdl (2)
Defiu weale nnay shokh akhlil (2)
